Sample JTBD survey data

Source: R/data.R
jtbd_sample.Rd

A synthetic dataset containing 200 survey respondents who rated the importance and satisfaction of 12 objectives across 3 job steps on a 1-5 Likert scale. Includes a segmentation column with three user types that have different response patterns.

Usage

jtbd_sample

Format

A data frame with 200 rows and 26 columns. Key columns include caseid (respondent ID), segment (user type factor), and 24 paired importance/satisfaction columns following the imp__step.objective / sat__step.objective naming convention.
